Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round fifteen

Wavy, not jaggy

Round fourteen with softer, wavier outlines, after the illustration you shared. Instead of many fine bumps, each protein’s edge has big, soft lobes with rounded dips between them. Some versions add soft lumps inside each protein, a shade lighter and darker, and an outline in a deeper shade of the protein’s own colour, as in the reference. Fill colours are the 3D story’s; the pearl and its linker are as before. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.
